about_the_game:
Have you ever wanted to raise your own Sacabambaspis? Now is your chance. It this cute idler you can get baby jawless fish for yourself and raise them to adulthood. Sell your adult Sacabambaspis for extra coin or see how long you can keep them alive! But don't forget to feed them or else their health might fade away! Once your bank is full, try feeding them more exotic foods for more exotic reactions and to help grow your friendship!

In this demo you can experience the full growth of your Sacabambaspis fish in your tank. Feed your fish to keep with alive with a subset of the food that you can experience in the full game. Beat the demo by saving enough money to feed your fish a chili for a special reaction, or play the demo forever and see ho long you can keep your fish alive. 

Purchase the full game to experience more types of food to feed your precious Sacabambaspis fish as well as use your in game currencies to buy decorations for your tank.

name: Jawless Fishtank Demo
short_description: Explore raising your very own Sacabambaspis in the casual fish tank idler. Save coins and feed fish various foods, sparking a various set of reactions. Name your Sacabambaspis and watch them grow before your eyes.
